FURTHER EXTENDING DEADLINES FOR STAFF AND
DIVISION OF PUBLIC ADVOCATE DIRECT
TESTIMONY AND RELATED DISCOVERY
WHEREAS, on June 23, 202I, the Commission entered Order No. 9831, which (a)
appointed the undersigned to serve as Hearing Examiner for this Docket, and (b) adopted a
procedural schedule related to proceedings in this Docket;
WHEREAS, on August3,202l, upon the joint request of Applicants, Veolia Environment
S.A., Veolia North America, Inc., SUEZ S.A., and SUEZ Water Delaware Inc. (collectively the
"Joint Applicants"), Commission Staff ("Staff'), and the Division of the Public Advocate
("DPA"), the undersigned Hearing Examiner entered Order No. 9852, extending certain deadlines
in the case in order to allow time for the parties to engage in settlement discussions as contemplated
by Order No. 9831;
WHEREAS, by email message sent to the Hearing Examiner on August 18,2021, counsel
for the Joint Applicants advised that the parties are engaged in settlement discussions, and
requested, on behalf of the Joint Applicants, Staff and the DPA, that certain deadlines in the

schedule be further amended to accommodate furlher discussion among the parties conceming
settlement; and
WHEREAS, the modifications to deadlines as jointly proposed by the parties will not affect
the hearing dates or other deadlines set pursuant to Order No. 9831;
WHEREAS, counsel for the Joint Applicants, Staff and the DPA all agree that the Hearing
Examiner is authorized to revise the procedural schedule as requested, by virtue of the powers
delegated to the Hearing Examiner in Paragraph 2 of Order No. 9831, and under Section 1'9.2 of
the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Commission,26Del. Admin. Code $ i001-1 .9.2; and
WHEREAS, there is good cause to extend the deadline for the filing of testimony by Staff
and DpA, and the subsequent deadlines for discovery, rebuttal testimony, and pre-hearing briefs,
NOW, THEREFORE, this 1 8th day of August 2027, pursuant to the authority granted to
me in pSC Order No. 983 i, dated June 23,2021, this Hearing Examiner, having considered the
application of the Joint Applicants, Staff and DPA as described above, orders as follows:
l. 
The joint request of the Joint Applicants, Staff and DPA to further extend the
deadline for the submission and filing of direct testimony by DPA and Staff, and to extend related
testimony, discovery and pre-hearing brief deadlines, as further specified in Paragraph 2 of this
Order, is granted.
